name: @workerv2/worker-host
description: Worker V2 Worker Host — the single composition root. It constructs and wires together every previously-built platform (control plane, coordinator, execution adapter, processor SDK, image backend + processors, composition, document, PDF export, artifact store, persistence) into a complete executable album-generation pipeline, with full dependency injection (no globals, no ambient state). It registers processors + image backends + repositories + artifact stores, configures capability negotiation, executes complete Runs (Blueprint → Manifest → Coordinator → processors → composition → Document → PDF export → PDF Artifact), and surfaces observational execution diagnostics. It implements NO rendering, NO PDF generation, NO business logic; it changes no Coordinator, Processor SDK, or orchestration semantics — it is purely wiring.
